summary: Cyclerion Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting shareholder votes on its merger agreement with Korsana Biosciences. Under the agreement, a subsidiary merges with Korsana, making it a wholly owned subsidiary, followed by a second merger. Cyclerion will issue shares (over 20% of its outstanding common stock) to Korsana stockholders. Shareholder meeting held August 26, 2026; 3,896,779 shares voted, constituting a quorum. The combined company will operate as Korsana Biosciences, Inc. The deal requires regulatory approvals and shareholder approvals. Watch for closing conditions and integration risks.
